ingredients.name: Biotinoyl Tripeptide-1
ingredients.summary: A peptide listed in the brand’s Procapil blend.
ingredients.identity: The manufacturer lists this peptide alongside apigenin and oleanolic acid in Procapil.
ingredients.evidence: This entry documents label identity. An academic efficacy review for this ingredient has not been completed here.
ingredients.limit: The blend name does not disclose a verified pure-peptide amount or prove the finished serum works.

ingredients.name: Acetyl Tetrapeptide-3
ingredients.summary: A peptide listed with red clover extract in the brand’s Capixyl blend.
ingredients.identity: The manufacturer identifies this peptide in Capixyl, a multi-ingredient system.
ingredients.evidence: A 32-person, 24-week trial examined another combination containing this peptide, not The Ordinary serum or the peptide alone.
ingredients.limit: Results cannot be transferred directly to this bottle or interpreted as proof of equivalence to minoxidil.
